description: The obligation created when a staked campaign resolves. Self-reported and counterparty-confirmed - Habiti never verifies or processes a payment. Import TWENTY-FIRST (depends on campaign_pledges)
notes: Flow: due -> self_reported_paid -> counterparty_confirmed. Habiti observes; it does not collect.
donation_link_url is SNAPSHOTTED onto the row so the agreed destination stays auditable even if the app's configured link changes later.
creditor_user_id is null when the beneficiary is the charity.
A campaign in 'disputed' FREEZES settlement - no row may advance while a report challenge is open.

creditor_user_id.description: Null when the beneficiary is the charity

donation_link_url.description: Snapshot of the iLuv Foundation / Project Africa link at the time the obligation arose

receipt_url.description: Optional proof supplied by the debtor
